title: Jesus before the Sanhedrin
description: When it became day, the council of elders gathered with the chief priests and scribes and brought Jesus before them. When asked if he is the Messiah, he answers that from now on the Son of Man will sit at the right hand of the Almighty. When they ask if he is the Son of God, he replies: "You say that I am." They then conclude that they need no further witnesses.
